## About

I am a Ph.D. candidate at **Shanghai Jiao Tong University** and an **incoming postdoc**.

::: {.hero-lead}
My work centers on **optimization**, **prediction**, **forecasting**, and **system modeling** for applied problems, with an emphasis on reliable and interpretable workflows.
:::

## Research Highlights

::: {.card-list}
::: {.entry-card}
#### Optimization and Prediction
I study how predictive models and optimization procedures can be combined to support careful application-level evaluation.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Forecasting and Modeling
I build forecasting and modeling workflows that integrate domain understanding, practical constraints, and interpretable methods.
:::
::: {.entry-card}
#### Reliable Applied Workflows
I design reusable workflows with staged checks, careful validation, and clear interfaces for recurring real-world studies.
:::
:::
